details.category: 窗口函数 LAG 环比
details.nl: 各季度GMV及环比增长率
details.gold_sql: SELECT t.quarter, t.gmv, ROUND((t.gmv - t.prev_gmv) / t.prev_gmv * 100, 2) AS growth_pct FROM (SELECT d.quarter, SUM(f.order_amount) AS gmv, LAG(SUM(f.order_amount)) OVER(ORDER BY MIN(d.date_id)) AS prev_gmv FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id GROUP BY d.quarter) t ORDER BY t.quarter
details.agent_sql:
WITH quarterly_gmv AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(LEFT(CAST(d.date_id AS CHAR), 4) AS UNSIGNED) AS order_year,
        d.quarter AS quarter_name,
        SUM(f.order_amount) AS gmv
    FROM fact_order f
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
    GROUP BY CAST(LEFT(CAST(d.date_id AS CHAR), 4) AS UNSIGNED), d.quarter
),
gmv_with_prev AS (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        quarter_name,
        gmv,
        LAG(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, quarter_name) AS prev_gmv
    FROM quarterly_gmv
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    quarter_name AS quarter,
    gmv,
    CASE
        WHEN prev_gmv IS NULL OR prev_gmv = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (gmv - prev_gmv) / prev_gmv * 100
    END AS gmv_mom_growth_rate
FROM gmv_with_prev
ORDER BY order_year, quarter_name;

details.nl: 2025年各月GMV及环比增长率
details.gold_sql: SELECT t.month, ROUND(t.gmv, 2) AS gmv, ROUND((t.gmv - LAG(t.gmv) OVER(ORDER BY t.month)) / LAG(t.gmv) OVER(ORDER BY t.month) * 100, 2) AS growth_pct FROM (SELECT d.month, SUM(f.order_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.month) t ORDER BY t.month
details.agent_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m + 1 FROM months WHERE m < 12
),
monthly_gmv AS (
  SELECT
    date_id DIV 100 AS ym,
    SUM(order_amount) AS gmv
  FROM fact_order
  WHERE date_id >= 20250101 AND date_id < 20260101
  GROUP BY date_id DIV 100
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT
    CONCAT('2025-', LPAD(m, 2, '0')) AS month_id,
    202500 + m AS ym
  FROM months
)
SELECT
  am.month_id AS `月份`,
  COALESCE(mg.gmv, 0) AS `GMV`,
  ROUND(
    (COALESCE(mg.gmv, 0) - LAG(COALESCE(mg.gmv, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY am.ym))
    / NULLIF(LAG(COALESCE(mg.gmv, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY am.ym), 0) * 100,
    2
  ) AS `环比增长率(%)`
FROM all_months am
LEFT JOIN monthly_gmv mg ON mg.ym = am.ym
ORDER BY am.ym;

details.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, r.province, COUNT(f.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(COUNT(f.order_id) / SUM(COUNT(f.order_id)) OVER(PARTITION BY r.region_name), 4) AS ratio_in_region FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name, r.province ORDER BY r.region_name, order_count DESC, r.province
details.agent_sql:
SELECT dr.region_name AS 大区,
       dr.province AS 省份,
       COUNT(fo.order_id) AS 订单数,
       ROUND(COUNT(fo.order_id) / SUM(COUNT(fo.order_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY dr.region_name), 4) AS 大区占比
FROM fact_order AS fo
INNER JOIN dim_region AS dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
GROUP BY dr.region_name, dr.province
ORDER BY dr.region_name, COUNT(fo.order_id) DESC;

details.nl: 铂金会员消费金额超过10万的品类
details.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(f.order_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.member_level = '铂金' GROUP BY p.category HAVING SUM(f.order_amount) > 100000 ORDER BY gmv DESC
details.agent_sql:
SELECT dp.category
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE dc.member_level = '铂金'
GROUP BY dp.category
HAVING SUM(fo.order_amount) > 100000;

details.nl: 各品类订单金额分档统计 (低<500/中500-5000/高>5000)
details.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(CASE WHEN f.order_amount < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN f.order_amount BETWEEN 500 AND 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mid_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN f.order_amount > 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_orders FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category
details.agent_sql:
SELECT
  p.category AS category,
  CASE
    WHEN f.order_amount < 500 THEN '低'
    WHEN f.order_amount <= 5000 THEN '中'
    ELSE '高'
  END AS amount_level,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_order_amount
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY
  p.category,
  CASE
    WHEN f.order_amount < 500 THEN '低'
    WHEN f.order_amount <= 5000 THEN '中'
    ELSE '高'
  END
ORDER BY
  p.category,
  FIELD(amount_level, '低', '中', '高');

details.nl: 消费金额排名前10的客户及其会员等级
details.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, c.member_level, ROUND(SUM(f.order_amount), 2) AS gmv, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(f.order_amount) DESC, c.customer_name) AS rn FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_name, c.member_level ORDER BY gmv DESC, c.customer_name LIMIT 10
details.agent_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.member_level, SUM(o.order_amount) AS consumption_amount
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.member_level
ORDER BY consumption_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

details.nl: 各季度销售额最高的大区
details.gold_sql: SELECT t.quarter, t.region_name, ROUND(t.gmv, 2) AS gmv FROM (SELECT d.quarter, r.region_name, SUM(f.order_amount) AS gmv, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY d.quarter ORDER BY SUM(f.order_amount) DESC, r.region_name) AS rn FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY d.quarter, r.region_name) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.quarter
details.agent_sql:
WITH quarterly_region_sales AS (
  SELECT
    d.quarter,
    r.region_name,
    SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.quarter ORDER BY SUM(f.order_amount) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM fact_order f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
  JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
  GROUP BY d.quarter, r.region_name
)
SELECT
  quarter,
  region_name,
  total_sales
FROM quarterly_region_sales
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY quarter, total_sales DESC;
